title: The conquest of Mexico: the fall of Tenochtitlan
goal: Read how Cortés and his indigenous allies took Tenochtitlan, and tell what happened to people and places with the passive voice.

items: Use the passive with *ser* to tell what happened to the Spaniards and to Tenochtitlan.
Say what Cortés did after reaching the coast of Mexico and who received him in Tenochtitlan.
Describe what happened to the Spaniards during the Noche Triste.
Explain why many historians say Spanish weapons alone do not explain the fall of Tenochtitlan.
Use the key words of the conquest: ally, emperor, soldier and siege.
